name: Cookied Cookie Consent
author: billyisalive | Sem Ashby

sections.description:
Cookied is the most affordable global cookie consent solution for WordPress. Get fully compliant cookie consent banners for GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and more.

Features:

  • 🌍 Global Compliance – Automatic region detection with rules for GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, APPI, and more
  • ⚡ Ultra Lightweight – Less than 10KB, non-blocking, won’t slow down your site
  • 🎨 Customizable – Match your brand colors, fonts, and messaging
  • 🔒 Script Blocking – Block analytics/marketing scripts until consent is given
  • 📱 Responsive – Beautiful on all devices with WCAG accessibility

Pricing:

  • Basic: €9.99/year (1 website)
  • Pro: €25/year (up to 3 websites, remove branding)
  • Agency plans available for 10+ websites

How It Works:

  1. Sign up at cookied.io
  2. Add your website and get your API key
  3. Install this plugin and enter your API key
  4. Customize your banner in the Cookied dashboard
  5. You’re compliant!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cookied-consent
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Cookied to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your API key from the Cookied dashboard
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Sign up at cookied.io and add your website. Your API key will be displayed in the website settings.

Is there a free plan?

Plans start at just €9.99/year. We’re already the most affordable solution on the market.

Does this slow down my website?

No! Our banner script is less than 10KB and loads asynchronously, so it won’t affect your page load times.

What regions are supported?

We support all major privacy regulations including GDPR (EU), CCPA (California), LGPD (Brazil), APPI (Japan), and more. The banner automatically adapts based on your visitor’s location.
